blurb: Guests practice various yoga styles such as Hatha, Ashtanga, and restorative yoga in a heated room to improve alignment, strength, flexibility, and relaxation. Classes emphasize stress reduction, healing, and mindful meditation techniques. New students are encouraged to arrive early to complete paperwork and get acquainted with the studio and instructor.
extraNote: Class cards are non-transferable and cannot be shared · Price increase effective April 1; contact by email if trouble paying
